steps.en: After the 1st letter, the driver's notice is picked up for an electronic reminder
steps.id: Setelah surat ke-1, notice driver dipilih untuk reminder elektronik
steps.why_en: The picking logic exists, but the scheduled process is switched off in all environment settings in the repo.
steps.why_id: Logika pemilihan ada, tetapi proses terjadwalnya dimatikan di semua pengaturan environment di repo.

steps.en: The latest mobile number of the driver is fetched from the government data source
steps.id: Nomor mobile terbaru driver diambil dari sumber data pemerintah
steps.why_en: The lookup is written but switched off in every environment setting in the repo, so the stored number is used.
steps.why_id: Pencarian sudah ditulis tetapi dimatikan di semua pengaturan environment di repo, jadi nomor lama yang dipakai.

steps.en: The driver's latest email address is also checked
steps.why_en: Only the mobile number is refreshed for an individual; no email check exists for individuals.
steps.why_id: Hanya nomor mobile yang diperbarui untuk individu; tidak ada pengecekan email untuk individu.

steps.en: Opted-out drivers and drivers without a usable mobile number are not messaged
steps.id: Driver yang opt out atau tanpa nomor mobile yang bisa dipakai tidak dikirimi pesan

steps.en: The message is built from a stored template for the 1st letter stage
steps.id: Pesan dibuat dari template tersimpan untuk tahap surat ke-1
steps.why_en: The wording of the stored template cannot be checked from the code.
steps.why_id: Isi kalimat template tersimpan tidak bisa dicek dari code.
